description: The resources of OpenSLR (Open Speech and Language Resources): speech corpora, lexicons, language models, noise and impulse response sets and software mirrors. Each resource is an instance whose meta gives its name, identifier, summary, category, licence, description and external address, and whose nodes are the files it is distributed as. It describes the resources and does not contain them; each resource is subject to the licence its own meta states.
name: OpenSLR resources
